name: BMF Bridge
description: Generic socket and file-backed BMF command/event bridge for Omegga plugins and BMF Desktop event inspection.
author: BMF

runtimeDir.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_RUNTIME_DIR, commandDir, or the standard Omegga-managed BMF runtime path is used.

commandDir.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime/commands. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_COMMAND_DIR or runtimeDir/commands is used.

eventLogPath.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime/events.jsonl. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_EVENTS_PATH or runtimeDir/events.jsonl is used.

socketPath.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime/socket.json. If blank, runtimeDir/socket.json is used.

preferredTransport.description: Preferred command/event transport. Use socket to prefer the BMF loopback broker and fall back to files when unavailable.

socketRole.description: Client role sent to the BMF socket broker.

socketSource.description: Source name sent in socket hello, command, and diagnostics envelopes.

tailEvents.description: Tail runtime/events.jsonl as a fallback event source.

tailEventsWhenSocketConnected.description: Continue tailing events.jsonl while the socket is connected. Disabled by default to avoid duplicate records.

readExistingEventLog.description: Read existing events.jsonl records on startup. Disabled by default so live views begin at current EOF.

eventPollIntervalMs.description: events.jsonl polling interval. Values below 250ms are clamped.

maxReadBytesPerPoll.description: Maximum events.jsonl bytes parsed per poll before dropping ahead to the most recent slice.

maxRecords.description: Maximum normalized records retained in memory for Omegga plugin consumers and BMF Desktop inspection.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for BMF command responses over socket or file fallback.

socketReconnectMs.description: Delay before reconnecting to the BMF socket broker after a disconnect. Set to 0 to disable reconnects.

statusWriteIntervalMs.description: Interval for writing bmf-bridge-status.json. Set to 0 to write only on status changes.

redactPrivateIpsOnExport.description: Also redact private IPv4 addresses in exported or requested sanitized records.
